title: Checking a part out and back in

steps.title: Open Files
steps.body: Files offers separate Drive documents, GitHub code, and Vault parts.

steps.title: Open Vault
steps.body: Choose Vault in the Files source selector or desktop pill row.

steps.title: Check storage status
steps.body: The header identifies the Vault repository and branch when configured. GitHub check-ins require an admin-enabled repository; otherwise this project uses legacy Drive storage.

steps.title: Check in a practice file
steps.body: Your private training project starts without Vault items. Choose a disposable file to create the first item.

steps.title: Describe the first check-in
steps.body: Select your practice file, enter an item name and required change description, then submit. If GitHub writes are enabled, wait for the job to finish indexing before continuing.

steps.title: Open the item
steps.body: With Recent activity selected, open the first item row. It should be the practice item you just created; if you have sorted or filtered the list, reset those controls first.

steps.title: Inspect history
steps.body: Open Versions. The first version records the filename, author, change description and storage provider. A GitHub version also shows its commit.

steps.title: Check it out
steps.body: Check out this item before editing it.

steps.title: See the holder
steps.body: The item detail names the checkout holder. You can check in a new version here.

steps.title: You are watching this item
steps.body: Checking the item out also watched it, unless you turned auto-watch off in Notification preferences. Watchers hear about new check-ins, change request decisions and checkout conflicts; the chevron picks which. Whether a notice arrives in Constellation, as a Slack DM, or both is set per event type in Notification preferences.

steps.title: Start a new check-in
steps.body: Choose New check-in for this item.

steps.title: Check in the changed file
steps.body: Select a second practice file and enter the required change description. Submit and wait for the dialog to close. GitHub posts to /api/vault/items/:id/github-versions and polls the job until INDEXED; legacy Drive posts to /api/vault/items/:id/versions. Successful check-in releases your checkout automatically.

steps.title: See both versions
steps.body: The earlier file stays in Versions. Open this tab again if needed.

steps.title: Open the BOM
steps.body: The BOM tab lists an assembly's linked parts. This new practice item has no BOM links yet.
